The '''Letev system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was situated between the [[Tavya system/Legends|Tavya]] and [[Jappe system/Legends|Jappe systems]].
